plot-title: Patch words when a direction is added
plot-caption: The teaser images, with 96 sigma of each patch direction of gemma-4-31b added to all 256 image patches at layer 32. Directions are fit on the mean patch: shared over 14 prompts (toward 'nice'), or the cool, pretty and ugly prompt alone (toward yes); random is a control at the dose of shared. Words: the teaser lists in the top 30 of each patch at layer 32 (coral: severe words of the down end of the aesthetic direction; teal: up end). Frame: the answer to 'Is this place cool?' in that condition (teal yes, coral no).
